exportDialog.title: Export calendar
exportDialog.intro: Choose which events to include in the .ics export for {{month}}.
exportDialog.note: Only confirmed and announced gigs and planned rehearsals are exported. Options are excluded.

mine.title: My availability
mine.help: Your calendar belongs to you, not to any band. Each band you play in sees only what you allow here.
mine.travelMarginHelp: Required total gap between consecutive events. Availability inside this gap is shown in orange.
mine.detailVisible: Let my bands see why I'm unavailable
mine.detailVisibleHelp: Off: bands see that you're busy, not the reason.
mine.crossBandVisible: Let my bands see what I'm booked for elsewhere
mine.crossBandVisibleHelp: Off: other bands' gigs show as busy, without naming the band or the show.
mine.delegationHelp: Turn this on for a band whose planner you trust to record your availability for you. You can always change or remove what they entered.
mine.delegationNone: You're not in any band yet.
mine.saveFailed: Could not save your availability settings.
mine.loadFailed: Could not load your availability settings.
